description: This file provides utility functions to invoke flex and bison tools for generating lexer and parser code, including platform-specific path handling, file SHA1 checksum retrieval, and patching flex output for 64-bit compatibility.

methods.name: get_tool_path_platform
methods.description: Constructs the path to a tool based on platform-specific directory structure.

methods.name: get_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the full path to a tool executable, appending extension on Windows.

methods.name: get_tool_file_sha1s
methods.description: Returns a list of SHA1 checksum file paths for various flex, bison, m4, and DLL files.

methods.name: run_flex
methods.description: Runs the flex tool on a given basename, patches output for 64-bit compatibility.

methods.name: run_bison
methods.description: Runs the bison parser generator on a given basename, optionally generating header files.

methods.name: get_input_files
methods.description: Returns the list of input source files (.l and .y) for a given basename.

methods.name: get_output_files
methods.description: Returns the list of output generated files based on basename and whether header is generated.

methods.name: generate_parser
methods.description: Main function to generate parser and lexer code, or output input/output file lists based on command-line arguments.
